name: Personal-Plugins
description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills, subagents, hooks, and MCP servers, distributed as installable plugins.

plugins.name: common-package
plugins.description: 자주 쓰는 공통 스킬 모음. README 작성/갱신 스킬(readme-writer)과 커밋 스킬(commit)을 포함하고, claude-md-management 플러그인을 함께 설치한다. A bundle of commonly used skills (readme-writer, commit); also pulls in the claude-md-management plugin.

plugins.name: developer-package
plugins.description: 개발 워크플로 메타 플러그인. feature-dev, context7, security-guidance, serena, playwright를 한 번에 설치한다. A meta-plugin that bundles the feature-dev, context7, security-guidance, serena, and playwright plugins.
